description: Reproduction pipeline and data: Water quantification, paid conservation, and unrecorded energy demand on the Colorado River is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Arif Gasilov (University of Arizona). Code and data supporting a study of water accounting asymmetries in the Colorado River Basin. Contains: pipeline.py, a single-script reproduction of all EIA-derived figures (deduplication of the EIA cooling detail files 2021-2024, plausibility screening against Macknick et al. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
